items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: That's right, Black Benny used to play with Chris too.

ctx.x: I wonder why that died out, you know? I wouldn't know. What's funny. It's funny. He used to do that all the time, the bands.
That's right, Black Benny used to play with Chris too. You heard of Black Benny. He was a right hand man.

And he played? He was a good drummer. And he played, did he play the slide whistle too? I don't remember him playing the slide whistle. But he played with Chris, yeah. Did you ever work with Black Benny?
